notes: On phones and tablets, menus no longer outline a button as if it were already chosen when a screen opens. Keyboards and controllers still get the outline.
"▼ MORE" at the bottom of a long list scrolls it when tapped, and now also shows on the Play and Settings pages.
Settings that are on turn green, so orange only marks the main thing to press.
iPhone and iPad open on the Blitzbreak logo instead of Godot's.
Mac: hosting a game explains why it asks to use your local network. Testers with a Mac can also install Blitzbreak from TestFlight.
